contract.intent: Frame the goal for building Ann: a tree-of-steps planning system that converts ambiguous human goals into executable step trees for downstream runners.
acceptanceCriteria: Goal statement preserves user intent: planning system, tree-of-steps execution, runners are agents/humans/automation
Success definition recorded: a downstream runner completes the user's goal using only the tree-derived context and ordinary project access
Design §21 (Tree-of-Steps Execution Model v2) is the canonical spec to build against
